experiments.scope: Selected target sha256-r31-prefix-v1. Completion step of proof.md Section 8 only, at the claimed caps (2^18 x, 2^14 z candidates), run on the three prefixes (first block M0 and second-block words W0..W12) of collisions the full algorithm found from random first blocks (certificates found-1..3), with search offsets derived from each organizer seed. The first-block search and table phases are not executed.
experiments.hypothesis: For the supplied prefixes, the capped completion search returns pairs of distinct 128-byte messages with equal 31-step SHA-256 digests; this demonstrates the completion mechanism, not a success probability.
